deliveredBuild.architecture: GPUI native shell/editor + mandatory single Wry/WebView2 reading area; no native Markdown fallback or worker.
deliveredBuild.cleanup: Project and three PoC Cargo targets cleaned (~22 GiB), retired native executables and renderer source/dependencies removed; shared global Cargo registry retained.
deliveredBuild.limitations: One 25s shutdown timeout occurred with concurrent build/GUI tests; serial reruns passed. Cold startup, soak, low-memory and non-Windows reading remain unverified.

previousDeliveredBuild.performance: Main matrix predates final image count and asynchronous WebView initialization fixes. Final full matrix not rerun after user stopped Computer Use.

buildHistory.fix: Create WebView2 after releasing the GPUI AppCell borrow; capture only the parent window handle inside cx.update.
buildHistory.performance: Existing memory/startup matrix predates the final initialization fixes; no new performance measurement claimed.

buildHistory.changes: Slim rounded arrowless WebView scrollbars; outline defaults to Jump. Includes previously verified AppCell reentrancy fix.
buildHistory.performance: Historical memory/startup matrix is unchanged; no new performance measurement claimed.
